{{Quote|Enjoy the bold taste of Socorro's black sands and rugged Killee Wasteland with this well-done slider. We top a blackened patty with four pieces of crispy tailring bacon and the Monnoks' smoky steak sauce.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Socorro slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Socorro sliders''' were one of the standard [[slider]]s on the menu at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Inspired by the [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|chef's]] travels across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] the slider was named for<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].<ref name="Black Sands of Socorro">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref> The slider consisted of a blackened [[Limb/Legends|hand]]-formed [[Mongo Beefhead patty]] with [[Monnoks' smoky steak sauce]], topped with four pieces of crispy [[tailring bacon]], and served on a [[medium-density food-board]] with the diner's [[Slider garnish|special garnish]]. The dish cost 6.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The diner offered [[Sernpidalian mayo-ketchup]] and [[Bimm mustard]] for the slider upon request. A Socorro slider could also be bought alongside another basic slider as a [[Talus and Tralus slider]] meal for 9.7 credits.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Socorro sliders were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
